policies.text: Priority maintenance service is assigned to systems with a continuous run duration exceeding 1000 hours.
Outdoor durability qualification is granted to hardware holding an IP67 water resistance certification.
Industrial deployment readiness requires a product with basic safety compliance that also delivers a peak electrical output of at least 40 kilowatts.
An equipment unit achieves basic safety compliance if it is cleared on thermal safety grounds.
Catalog listing is approved for models with industrial deployment readiness that offer a warranty period of 3 years or longer.
Commercial rebate authorization requires a minimum energy efficiency index of 88 points.
A low-noise classification requires noise emissions of 65 decibels or lower.

Thermal safety clearance is granted when an item exhibits an operating temperature of 85 degrees Celsius or lower, a heat dissipation rating of 120 watts or greater, or holds an ISO 9001 quality certificate.
Tier-one performance recognition requires an operational efficiency rating of 90 percent or higher.
